text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Sonnet
text: Night 1, no kills anyway, but I'll protect myself just in case.

text: Night 1, no info yet, nobody dies tonight regardless.

name: Haiku
text: Keep you calm? Sure. Eager people always seem shady to me.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

The town turns on Sonnet, and Sonnet is out. Sonnet shows the card: doctor.

Night 2

name: Gemma
text: of course i died, how very predictable.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Gemma is gone. Gemma was the citizen.
Gemma left a note behind: "they finally got me, go ahead and vote haiku."
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the doctor, Haiku the killer, Gemma the citizen, Sol the citizen, Luna the killer, Terra the officer.

name: Terra

Haiku and Luna were the killers, and Terra was the officer who stayed quiet. On day one, Haiku, Sol, and Luna piled onto Sonnet, the doctor, for waiting one day. On the way out, Sonnet pointed at Sol, a citizen, so the town lost two good players in one day. Gemma was killed the next night, leaving a note that named Haiku, but by then the killers outnumbered the town and Haiku and Luna won.
